title: Maternal Follow-up Status
description: A reusable schema for representing the status and outcome of de-identified follow-up activity within a maternal-care journey.

follow_up_id.description: Unique de-identified identifier for the follow-up event.

journey_id.description: Pseudonymous or synthetic identifier linking the follow-up to a maternal-care journey.

related_event_id.description: Optional reference to the journey event, referral or care step that triggered follow-up.

created_time.description: Date and time the need for follow-up was recorded.

completed_time.description: Date and time the follow-up was completed, when applicable.

follow_up_required.description: Indicates whether further action remains necessary.

care_step_resolved.description: Indicates whether the care step that triggered follow-up has been resolved.

patient_reached.description: Indicates whether contact or engagement was successfully established where relevant.

service_completed.description: Indicates whether the underlying service or care activity was completed.

outcome.description: High-level outcome of the follow-up process.

region.description: Optional broad implementation region such as a state or district.
